components/brand-button.tsx.name: Brand pill button
components/brand-button.tsx.description: Renders the arbitrum.io pill button as a Fumadocs Link with primary, secondary and on-dark variants sharing the cyan-glow hover.

components/footer.tsx.name: Site footer
components/footer.tsx.description: Renders the arbitrum.io-style link columns as a sibling of the layout, dark in both modes and styled with brand tokens.

components/home-header.tsx.name: Home navbar
components/home-header.tsx.description: Client navbar for the landing page and 404, matching the notebook header DOM so the shared navbar CSS applies; copied from fumadocs-ui 16.15.9.

components/home-hero.tsx.name: Home hero
components/home-hero.tsx.description: Renders the landing hero panel: gradient, scan texture, seven navy slashes and the copy, with the texture preloaded as the LCP image.

components/nav-label.tsx.name: Nav section label
components/nav-label.tsx.description: Marks a top nav item active when the current page's root sidebar folder contains any of the given section URLs.

components/PageActionsPopover.tsx.name: Open page menu
components/PageActionsPopover.tsx.description: Server-rendered Open menu with GitHub, Markdown, ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor links, replacing Fumadocs' hard-coded ViewOptionsPopover.

components/RequestUpdateLink.tsx.name: Request update link
components/RequestUpdateLink.tsx.description: Server component linking to a prefilled GitHub issue for the current page, built from gitConfig and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

components/sidebar-collapse-button.tsx.name: Sidebar collapse toggle
components/sidebar-collapse-button.tsx.description: Client toggle placed in the docs navbar via nav.children; needs DocsLayout's SidebarProvider, so it must stay off the home layout.

components/sidebar-resource-links.tsx.name: Sidebar resource links
components/sidebar-resource-links.tsx.description: Renders the Chain info, Glossary and Contribute shortcuts under the sidebar tree, outside the page tree so they claim no root.

components/ui/button.tsx.name: Button variants
components/ui/button.tsx.description: Defines the cva buttonVariants class builder with primary, outline, ghost and secondary styles plus sm and icon sizes.
